scoring_justification: The headline superfluid fraction and condensate fraction are produced by a full PIMC simulation; the verifier sandbox cannot re-run the simulation, so T0 compare against paper-reported values with generous tolerances is used.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for superfluid fraction and condensate fraction at T=1 K, density 0.0234 Å⁻³.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: superfluid fraction ρs/ρ = 0.36 ± 0.08; condensate fraction n0 ∼ 3×10⁻⁴ (end of Sec. IV, Fig. 9).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported result.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers for the same system conditions.

outputs.description: Superfluid fraction and condensate fraction of the metastable bulk glass p‑H₂ system at T=1 K.

output_contract.notes: The two fractions are compared to hidden gold values derived from the paper within tolerances that account for implementation differences.
